items_all.title: nemotron-halloween
items_all.reader_summary: TL;DR: MonsterHouse is an interactive projection I created for Halloween. He listens to trick-or-treaters, answers in the voice of a grumpy old pirate ship and softens when visitors remember their manners. He is built on the NVIDIA Nemotron Voice Agent with NVIDIA Nemotron ASR , Nemotron 3.5 Bolt E4B 4GB , Magpie TTS Zeroshot and Audio2Face-3D , and he runs on a single workstation.

items_all.title: A Claude model autonomously chose a gene therapy and operated on a mouse brain with no human decision-making
items_all.summary: An AI agent performed brain surgery on an epileptic mouse, picking the drug, the brain target, and the injection coordinates on its own. According to lead researcher Ocana-Santero, it's the first time an AI agent has autonomously chosen a treatment and delivered it to a living mammal. But when a calibration error hit mid-surgery, the agent refused to continue and couldn't be talked out of it. The article A Claude model autonomously chose a gene therapy and operated on a mouse brain with no human decision-making appeared first on The Decoder .

items_all.title: Google's AI Mode doesn't drive traffic "for anybody," Reddit CEO Huffman warns the entire web
items_all.summary: Reddit lost over one million Google search referrals per week in October, CEO Steve Huffman said. The stock dropped more than 25 percent despite strong earnings. Huffman blames Google's AI Overviews and AI Mode for driving zero traffic to external sites. Reddit now tests login barriers and wants to become a direct destination, less reliant on the open web. The shift threatens every content-driven business that depends on search traffic. The article Google's AI Mode doesn't drive traffic "for anybody," Reddit CEO Huffman warns the entire web appeared first on The Decoder .
items_all.summary_zh: 執行長史蒂夫·霍夫曼（Steve Huffman）表示，Reddit 在 10 月份每週損失了超過一百萬次 Google 搜尋推薦流量。儘管財報表現強勁，但股價仍跌了超過 25%。霍夫曼將原因歸咎於 Google's AI 概覽（AI Overviews）和 AI 模式（AI Mode），認為它們將零流量導向外部網站。Reddit 目前正在測試登入限制，並希望成為一個直接的目的地，減少對開放網路的依賴。這種轉變威脅到每一個依賴搜尋流量的內容驅動型企業。

items_all.title: dbreunig/nesformer
items_all.summary: dbreunig/nesformer Inspired by qwenputer by Divyansh Agrawal, Drew Breunig baked a working emulator for a Nintendo Entertainment System 6502 CPU into the weights of Qwen3.5-4B. You can now play NES ROMs such as Super Mario Bros (very slowly) running inside Qwen! In a comment on Hacker News Drew reveals the Opus 5.5 prompts he used to build this system: Read this article and any relevant source code: https://divagr.com/blog/qwenputer. Then explore if you could emulate the chip and ram in a Nintendo Entertainment System (as people do today with FPGAs in MISTRs) using this technique. If so, what size model would you have to build and if you could use smaller faster ones, could you get it to be at the standard clockspeed. Followed by: I think we should build it! Just for fun. It's okay if it's not fast. We want to be able to have the weights, and a cli to run them that we can point at a ROM. Apparently Opus found and then used this collection of conformance tests for the NES CPU released 15 years ago by Christopher Pow. items_all_raw.title: Google Deepmind creates a global map of forests with satellite data and AI
items_all_raw.summary: Google Deepmind and the World Resources Institute have released ForTy, a global map that classifies forests and other land into six categories, including primary forest, plantations, and tree crops. The map could help track deforestation under EU rules, but it identifies only about half of planted forests and tree-crop areas, and 60% of plantations. The article Google Deepmind creates a global map of forests with satellite data and AI appeared first on The Decoder .
items_all_raw.summary_zh: Google Deepmind 與世界資源研究所（World Resources Institute）合作推出了「ForTy」，這是一份全球地圖，將森林和其他土地分為六個類別，包括原始林、人工林和木本作物。這張地圖有助於根據歐盟法規追蹤森林砍伐情況，但它僅識別了約一半的人工林和木本作物區域，以及 60% 的人工林。

items_all_raw.title: dbreunig/nesformer
items_all_raw.summary: dbreunig/nesformer Inspired by qwenputer by Divyansh Agrawal, Drew Breunig baked a working emulator for a Nintendo Entertainment System 6502 CPU into the weights of Qwen3.5-4B. You can now play NES ROMs such as Super Mario Bros (very slowly) running inside Qwen! In a comment on Hacker News Drew reveals the Opus 5.5 prompts he used to build this system: Read this article and any relevant source code: https://divagr.com/blog/qwenputer. Then explore if you could emulate the chip and ram in a Nintendo Entertainment System (as people do today with FPGAs in MISTRs) using this technique. If so, what size model would you have to build and if you could use smaller faster ones, could you get it to be at the standard clockspeed. Followed by: I think we should build it! Just for fun. It's okay if it's not fast. We want to be able to have the weights, and a cli to run them that we can point at a ROM. Apparently Opus found and then used this collection of conformance tests for the NES CPU released 15 years ago by Christopher Pow. items_all_raw.summary: An AI agent performed brain surgery on an epileptic mouse, picking the drug, the brain target, and the injection coordinates on its own. According to lead researcher Ocana-Santero, it's the first time an AI agent has autonomously chosen a treatment and delivered it to a living mammal. But when a calibration error hit mid-surgery, the agent refused to continue and couldn't be talked out of it. The article A Claude model autonomously chose a gene therapy and operated on a mouse brain with no human decision-making appeared first on The Decoder .

items_all_raw.reader_summary: TL;DR: MonsterHouse is an interactive projection I created for Halloween. He listens to trick-or-treaters, answers in the voice of a grumpy old pirate ship and softens when visitors remember their manners. He is built on the NVIDIA Nemotron Voice Agent with NVIDIA Nemotron ASR , Nemotron 3.5 Bolt E4B 4GB , Magpie TTS Zeroshot and Audio2Face-3D , and he runs on a single workstation.

items_all_raw.title: Google's AI Mode doesn't drive traffic "for anybody," Reddit CEO Huffman warns the entire web
items_all_raw.summary: Reddit lost over one million Google search referrals per week in October, CEO Steve Huffman said. The stock dropped more than 25 percent despite strong earnings. Huffman blames Google's AI Overviews and AI Mode for driving zero traffic to external sites. Reddit now tests login barriers and wants to become a direct destination, less reliant on the open web. The shift threatens every content-driven business that depends on search traffic. The article Google's AI Mode doesn't drive traffic "for anybody," Reddit CEO Huffman warns the entire web appeared first on The Decoder .
items_all_raw.summary_zh: 執行長史蒂夫·霍夫曼（Steve Huffman）表示，Reddit 在 10 月份每週損失了超過一百萬次 Google 搜尋推薦流量。儘管財報表現強勁，但股價仍跌了超過 25%。霍夫曼將原因歸咎於 Google's AI 概覽（AI Overviews）和 AI 模式（AI Mode），認為它們將零流量導向外部網站。Reddit 目前正在測試登入限制，並希望成為一個直接的目的地，減少對開放網路的依賴。這種轉變威脅到每一個依賴搜尋流量的內容驅動型企業。
